groups.title: Find and review evidence
groups.description: Discover publications, verify references, monitor new work, and build auditable evidence reviews.

groups.title: Plan research
groups.description: Challenge claims, formulate hypotheses, choose a study design, and justify sample size before collecting data.

groups.title: Analyze data and evidence
groups.description: Retrieve structured records and analyze quantitative, qualitative, image, and life-science material with traceable decisions.

groups.title: Communicate results
groups.description: Create figures, diagrams, manuscripts, reviews, and venue-ready LaTeX without losing the evidence trail.

groups.title: Prepare sources and extend the workspace
groups.description: Normalize source files, capture Evidence Lab meetings, and turn a recurring personal workflow into a portable skill.

skills.use_when: You need papers, preprints, identifiers, citation links, or open-access copies from scholarly databases.
skills.produces: A source-linked paper list with identifiers, metadata, and retrieval provenance.

skills.use_when: You need to verify citation metadata, resolve a DOI, repair references, or create BibTeX.
skills.produces: Verified citation records and normalized BibTeX entries.

skills.use_when: You are planning or conducting a narrative, rapid, scoping, or structured literature review.
skills.produces: A review protocol, search and screening record, evidence table, appraisal, and synthesis.

skills.use_when: Your review requires explicit eligibility criteria, reproducible searches, deduplication, and auditable screening decisions.
skills.produces: A systematic-search record, deduplicated study set, and screening ledger with decision reasons.

skills.use_when: You want a repeatable alert or update scan for new publications rather than a one-time search.
skills.produces: A documented monitoring query, stable deduplication keys, and source-linked update digest.

skills.use_when: You need to challenge a scientific claim, causal statement, assumption, bias, confounder, or evidence grade.
skills.produces: A structured claim and evidence audit with assumptions, alternatives, and unresolved gaps.

skills.use_when: You need to turn observations into testable questions, rival hypotheses, predictions, and measurements.
skills.produces: An evidence-bounded hypothesis matrix and preregistration-ready analysis outline.

skills.use_when: You are choosing controls, randomization, blocking, treatment combinations, or another design before data collection.
skills.produces: A study design specification with allocation logic, controls, estimands, and validity checks.

skills.use_when: You need sample size, minimum detectable effect, power curves, or a defensible power justification.
skills.produces: A reproducible power calculation or simulation with assumptions and sensitivity analysis.

skills.use_when: A fact or record must be retrieved reproducibly from a named public database API.
skills.produces: A documented API query with filters, pagination, returned records, and provenance.

skills.use_when: You need to profile supported research files, inspect missingness, leakage, outliers, or transformation sensitivity.
skills.produces: A bounded data-quality and exploratory-analysis report with reproducible summaries.

skills.use_when: You need to choose and run statistical tests, check assumptions, estimate effects, or report results.
skills.produces: An analysis plan, calculations, diagnostics, effect sizes, and reporting-ready results.

skills.use_when: You need traceable coding and thematic synthesis of interviews, field notes, open responses, or text corpora.
skills.produces: A codebook, coded excerpts, reflexive notes, disagreements, negative cases, and themes.

skills.use_when: Calculations require unit checking, uncertainty propagation, measurement budgets, or significant-figure review.
skills.produces: Dimensionally checked calculations and a transparent uncertainty budget or propagation record.

skills.use_when: You are inspecting microscopy, experimental photographs, scans, or instrument images as research evidence.
skills.produces: A provenance-aware image inspection record with transformations, measurements, exclusions, and limits.

skills.use_when: A study or image workflow needs biological controls, protocol checks, acquisition metadata, or biosafety boundaries.
skills.produces: A life-science protocol and reporting checklist with missing controls and metadata gaps.

skills.use_when: You need to design or audit a truthful, accessible, publication-ready data figure.
skills.produces: A figure specification or generated chart with uncertainty, accessibility, metadata, and export checks.

skills.use_when: You need a versionable workflow, timeline, concept map, architecture, or screening diagram.
skills.produces: Editable Mermaid source embedded in consistently structured Markdown.

skills.use_when: You need to draft, rewrite, shorten, expand, translate, or polish evidence-bounded prose.
skills.produces: A new or revised text with explicit audience, voice, evidence, and uncertainty boundaries.

skills.use_when: You are reviewing an authorized manuscript, protocol, preprint, proposal, or revision response.
skills.produces: A structured, evidence-bounded review with prioritized findings and actionable revision requests.

skills.use_when: A manuscript must compile and comply with current journal, conference, repository, or funder requirements.
skills.produces: Compile-ready LaTeX sources, diagnostics, a compliance report, and submission package checks.

skills.use_when: PDF, Office, data, archive, audio, or supported web material must become normalized Markdown.
skills.produces: Markdown suitable for inspection, search, evidence extraction, or downstream analysis.

skills.use_when: An Evidence Lab transcript or rough meeting note must become a source-bounded project record.
skills.produces: A structured meeting summary ready for the canonical Evidence Lab meeting register.

skills.use_when: A researcher wants to turn a repeated personal workflow into a reusable Codex or Claude Code skill.
skills.produces: A small portable skill with a clear trigger, procedure, boundaries, tests, and validation result.
